paragraph: Today’s Granville composite reading registers at a constructive 63 out of 100 with zero breadth divergence warnings active, setting a moderately bullish primary verdict for the session. Internal market health is supported by strong equal-weight leadership with the RSP/SPY ratio climbing +1.39%, alongside encouraging economic participation from transports gaining +0.71% and a calming VIX dropping -2.31% to a tranquil level of 16.52. Macro conditions offer a favorable tailwind as the volatility term structure remains in a steep contango from 10.9 up to 19.0, while high-yield credit spreads hold steady at 3.14% and 10-year real yields anchor at 2.64%. These positive cross-currents outweigh isolated weakness in bellwether semis, which dropped -1.11%, and risk appetite indicators like SPHB/SPLV falling -0.99%. Expect the market to maintain its upward bias today, favoring a cautiously bullish directional lean for the trading session.
